observations.label: Peter stands with the Eleven

payload.posture: Read Acts 2:1–21 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states at Pentecost Peter addresses the crowd, denies the charge of drunkenness, and begins interpreting what they hear through Joel. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: Peter stands with the Eleven
